en: "Argh! I had a fight with Nozomi-san next door and we split up!"{KP}"Sure! I'm the one at fault for putting on a {bb}Cat Suit{ww} and scaring her!"{KP}"But she didn't have to slap me! Ten times, no less!"{KP}"Argh! Capital of Hope, my foot! More like the Capital of Despair!"{KP}"......But"{KP}"I want to get back together with her... What should I do? Hey?! Momotaro-san!"{KP}"Maybe I should send her some flowers or something?"{KP}"Momotaro-san! Could you go and give her flowers for me?!"{KP}"I'll leave the kind of flower up to you, Momotaro-san!"

jp:
「ありがとう　桃太郎さん！
　さっき　窓越しに　のぞみさんが
　ゆるすわって　言ってくれたよ！」{KP}
　
「お礼に　旅の商人から　買った
　この　{bb}ネコぐるみ{ww}を　あげるよ！
　オイラには　もう　必要ないから！」
en: "Thank you, Momotaro-san! Just now, Nozomi-san told me through the window that she forgives me!"{KP}"As thanks, take this {bb}Cat Suit{ww} I bought from a traveling merchant! I don't need it anymore!"

jp:
「ありがとう　桃太郎さん！
　今は　おたがいの　家を
　行ったり　来たりしていますよ！」
en: "Thank you, Momotaro-san! These days we're always going back and forth between each other's houses!"
